hero: Based in South Jakarta, Hope Charity Indonesia connects compassion with community needs through social support, humanitarian work, education, and religious facilities.
profile: Hope Charity Indonesia brings people together for social, humanitarian, and religious initiatives—helping compassion reach more people and create lasting benefits.
story: Based in South Jakarta, Yayasan Hope Charity Indonesia works in social, humanitarian, and religious fields. Its scope includes education, basic community needs, and places of worship.

We bring together supporters, partners, volunteers, and communities to develop purposeful programs. Each step is guided by the foundation’s objectives, needs on the ground, and organizational readiness.
vision: To be a trustworthy, professional, and reliable social, humanitarian, and religious foundation that creates lasting benefits and improves community welfare.
mission: Five commitments guide the work of Hope Charity Indonesia.
missions: Develop responsive, relevant, and measurable programs that address basic community needs.
Improve access to learning and help people develop their potential through structured educational activities.
Places of worship and religious guidance
Support worship facilities, religious guidance, and inclusive community outreach.
Work towards access to clean water, wells, suitable sanitation, and assistance with basic needs.
Collaborate with individuals, communities, businesses, and institutions that share a commitment to care.
values: Honor the trust placed in us and use each contribution for its agreed purpose.
Respond with empathy, respect human dignity, and understand community needs.
Plan, carry out, and evaluate activities in an orderly and responsible way.
Promote clear activity reporting and accountability in the use of resources.
Build lasting partnerships to extend the reach of positive change.
program: From places of worship to humanitarian assistance, our programs are designed around community needs. Implementation follows the foundation’s priorities and readiness.
feature: Mosque and prayer-room construction and renovation are the main priority ready to be undertaken. The wider scope also includes Islamic boarding schools, madrasahs, and religious guidance.
about: Spreading hope and sharing kindness through purposeful care.
contact: We welcome collaboration with individuals, communities, institutions, and businesses that want to make a positive contribution together.
contactDetails: Jl. Gintung No. 6, Tanjung Barat, Jagakarsa, Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta 12530
concept: Profile adapted from foundation materials. Illustrative images and sample figures remain placeholders for review.
focusIntro: These fields describe the foundation’s scope of activities. Their inclusion does not mean all programs are already operating; implementation follows organizational priorities and readiness.
focusAreas: Construction and renovation of mosques, prayer rooms, Islamic boarding schools, and madrasahs, alongside religious education and community guidance.
Formal and nonformal education, skills courses, social research, academic forums, talent and arts development, and leadership training.
Clean-water facilities, well drilling in drought-prone areas, and public sanitation, washing, and toilet facilities.
Basic necessities, care and assistance for orphaned children, support for older people in need, and micro-scale economic empowerment.
Emergency supplies for disaster-affected people, assistance for displaced communities, and humanitarian support during social emergencies.
partnersIntro: We welcome partners who share our commitment to care and want to contribute in ways that meet program needs.
partnerships: Non-binding grants and contributions to support programs.
Working together on social, humanitarian, educational, and worship-facility projects.
Professional skills, technical advice, equipment, and operational facilities.
Corporate social responsibility partnerships to extend the benefits of programs.
